problem.lede: We are extending the Zcash application layer so human coordination can settle under proofs anyone can check. The grant stack brings selective disclosure, light clients, and authentication turnstiles into environments where DAOs and apps already compose.
problem.p1Body: Correctness is something outsiders can check. Verify APIs, named tests, and public demos are part of the craft, so claims settle under mathematics that holds up under review.
problem.p2Body: Selective disclosure opens only the fields a policy needs. Membership and preference can stay private by default for DAOs that want Zcash-grade guarantees in their app layer.
problem.p3Body: Code, specs, and demos live in public. The residual is built to be audited, inherited, and extended by builders who will come after this grant.
problem.sitsBody: A selective-disclosure contract VM and light clients that speak Zcash-grade proofs, curves, and headers. Counterparty chains root their own consensus state. Light clients carry the Zcash header view those applications need so composition can use real consensus facts.
problem.deliversBody: In-contract proof verification. Header and finality updates into light clients. Claims bound to smart accounts. Authentication turnstiles for membership, voting, and access. A community audit and design-space hackathon on the elevated ZecHub bounty surface, with holder ranking.
problem.pathTitle: The path · Verify → Update → Bind → Turnstile
problem.pathIntro: Four steps from a checked proof to a controlled action on the application layer. Each step is meant to be reproducible by someone outside the team.
problem.step1Plain: Verify · settle Zcash-grade proofs in the selective-disclosure contract VM.
problem.step1Tech: Verification-key storage and a clear verify API on the proof VM.
problem.step2Plain: Update · carry Zcash headers and finality into light clients contracts can read.
problem.step2Tech: Header and Crosslink finality on the IBC light-client path.
problem.step3Plain: Bind · attach verified claims to smart accounts and authenticators.
problem.step4Plain: Turnstile · open membership, voting, and access through custom smart-account authentication turnstiles.
problem.step4Tech: DAO plugins and wallet-derived session material powered by the grant stack.
problem.pathCaption: Verify → Update → Bind → Turnstile · Zcash application layer
problem.foldBody: The designs will evolve. The principles will not. Selective disclosure, coinholder-style commitments, and Crosslink-aware header paths stay aligned with Zcash crypto and ZIPs. We document maturity honestly, ship with tests, and leave room for community audit so the work can outlast this residual.

events.lede: This product surface hosts two community programs: a community-led audit and a design-space hackathon. ZEC holders rank standout demos and audit impact on the open board.
events.timelineLede: Both programs share one elevated ZecHub bounty surface, compute credits, and holder ranking. Role tabs describe how each participant joins.
events.tl1Body: Reviewers study the stack and file improvements and vulnerabilities for holder ranking.
events.tl2Body: Builders ship demos on the proof VM, light clients, and authentication turnstiles. Follows the audit window.
events.tl3Body: ZEC holders rank the top 10 demos for a shared bonus and rank audit work by impact on this design.
events.bountyBody: This plane elevates open-source work ZecHub already runs. We connect those projects so audit, hackathon, compute credits, and holder ranking share one path.
events.oss1: ZecHub/zec-bounties is the bounty board with native ZEC payments, built with ZecHub community builders led by @onajifortune.
events.oss2: DAO-DAO hosts the governance UI so the board embeds where ZecHub and peer DAOs already coordinate.
events.oss3: Grant stack authentication powers registration and elevated board access with smart-account turnstiles, Zcash-aligned claim checks, and wallet-derived session material, plus compute mint and redeem and holder ranking on that surface.
events.stackBody1: Participants use the grant stack for every elevated step. Authentication turnstiles gate registration and board access with verified claims. Review and demos settle those claims on the proof VM. Light clients bring Zcash headers and finality into the paths that need them.
events.sg1Body: Grant stack turnstiles and wallet-derived sessions open elevated board paths.
events.sg2Body: Sponsored credits support auditors and builders while they work.
events.sg3Body: Opt-in audit traces feed the open dataset delivered with this grant.
